title: Sunrise worth the early start
text: We arrived before six and had the reflecting pool almost to ourselves. Bring a torch for the walk in, and stay for the light on the towers afterwards.

title: Clear water, quiet end of the beach
text: Walked twenty minutes past the pier and found an empty stretch of sand. The boat back fills up fast, so get there early.

title: Go early, dress covered
text: The Silver Pagoda is the highlight. Shoulders and knees must be covered, and the middle of the day gets very hot in the courtyards.

title: Tasting straight off the vine
text: The farm walk explains the difference between green, black and red pepper, and you taste each one. We came away with a bag of every kind.
